text:
anna: Heads-up — rough idea for migrating v1 API clients to new v2 routing without a big blast window. Suggest we use a gradual feature-flagged routing layer in the gateway that can route on a per-tenant basis + canary percentage. Thoughts?
mike: sounds promising. can we avoid maintaining two full runtimes? that was painful last time.
jess: agree with mike. if gateway handles routing to v1/v2 model variants we can keep runtimes mostly unchanged. need to be careful with KV cache compatibility though.
anna: right — plan is: 1) gateway flag per-tenant: `compat_mode=on|off|percent`, 2) gateway rewrites minimal headers so runtimes see the expected shape, 3) add telemetry traces to verify token-level latency/cost differences, 4) automatic rollback if regressions detected.
leon: how do we detect regressions? compare p95 latency + sampling of reference prompts to check output deltas?
sophia: yes — telemetry + automated eval: send periodic golden prompts through both paths and compute a similarity metric; if quality delta > X% trigger rollback. ops-bot: deploy scheduled: gateway patch v1.2 -> feature flags enabled in staging 2024-05-03 17:00 UTC.
mike: what about auth / signer changes? v2 introduced `X-Client-Proto` optional header. If gateway strips/rewrites that we need to keep handshake safety.
anna: gateway will preserve `X-Client-Proto` when compat_mode=off. When compat_mode=on we add a stable shim header `X-Compat-Proto: v1` so downstream sees legacy shape. We'll document that.
jess: +1. Also request/response sizes might change. suggest we enable body-length quotas on compat routes to catch accidental regressions.
sophia: ops note: when we flip percentages, we should do small increments (1%, 5%, 10%) and run synthetic load for 10 mins at each step. rollback if error rate > 0.5% or p95 increases > 20%.
leon: how long do we keep the shim? decouple timeframe from flag — owners must schedule a removal RFC within 90 days of 100% migration. otherwise we add tech debt ticket.
anna: agreed. add telemetry tag `compat_flag_owner` and `compat_flag_expires` so we can query lingering shims.
mike: performance concern: per-tenant routing adds lookup on every request. cache entries for 1s should be fine. just watch hot tenants.
jess: we also need end-to-end tests in CI that simulate both modes. maybe a new `compat` test matrix in our integration suite.
sophia: ops-bot: added runbook stub: if we see a spike in token errors on compat route, set feature flag `compat_mode=off` for affected tenants and notify #incidents.
anna: plan for telemetry dashboards: cost delta by token, p95 latency split by route, golden-prompt similarity trend, percentage migrated. I'll mock dashboards and share RFC next week.
leon: nit: name the flag `compat_routing` not `compat_mode` to be explicit.
anna: done — will update. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: NOTE: next gateway deploy window is 2024-05-03 17:00 UTC. rolling deploy; healthcheck on /_health for each shard.
